moments.title: Her strategy is to balance out her husband's risk by owning the stability bucket
moments.summary: A participant says her husband already takes a lot of risk, so her plan is to work the stability bucket — maximising returns within it and keeping more liquidity — and she jokes that she now has a little arsenal with him.
moments.evidence: my husband already does a lot of hydro stuff and my strategy to balance him out now is to really look at the stability bucket
